verdict.rationale: Gumroad is a SaaS e-commerce platform that handles creator and buyer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any policy or control that keeps user data out of AI model training. A community note that the codebase uses OpenAI for moderation concerns vendor integrations, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
